name: Sydney Gruters

items.text: In 2025, two former New College Foundation finance officers said they were ousted in 2023 for objecting to donor-restricted money going toward the president's pay. Former board members sent Gruters, the foundation's executive director, and the president a demand letter seeking an audit. The college cited a clean state audit. A scholarship family has sued the foundation.
items.why: The allegations are about how the foundation and college used restricted funds (criterion 6), but no court or regulator has made a finding, and the pages I read don't tie Gruters personally to any specific misuse.
The search found no foreign-government payments, foreign-agent filings or foreign-linked donors, so there is no conduct to weigh under foreign ties.

for_review: I couldn't read the full Suncoast Searchlight page. It cut off partway through, before the college's internal audit and the section on the May draft complaint. I didn't open Gruters's own Sarasota Herald-Tribune op-ed responding to the Lentini suit, or the Auditor General 'clean audit' report. A DCCC page quotes the draft complaint as saying Corcoran and Gruters 'may have used' over $1M against donors' wishes. That page is a partisan source and I did not use it. A search snippet from Inside Higher Ed (Nov 2024) says a college internal audit found the foundation had at times tapped restricted funds and run deficits. I didn't open it. Please check whether the demand-letter threat of a lawsuit, or the Lentini case, has had any court ruling since. The owner-sites search (alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org, infowars.com) turned up nothing about her. Her work as a congressional district director and USDA state director is background only, and Wikipedia was used just as a map.
